## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Roster → **Store Vendors** (`/storevendors`). Breadcrumb: Dashboard / Vendors.

Store Vendors lists vendors operating under the in-store buyback model (see [Cashkr Store Flow](/cashkr-store-flow)).

## Filters & search

- **Search** — search box at the top right.
- **Filters** — opens the filter row:
  - **Status** — Order Generated, Assigned, Out For Pickup, InspectionStarted, Completed.
  - **Type** — device type: Mobile, Laptop, Macbook, Tablet, AC, Desktop, Camera, Console, TV, Headphone, Watch, Drone.
  - **City**
  - **From / To date**
  - **Reset** and **Apply Filters**.

## What the screen shows

When no store vendors match, the screen shows "No Vendors Found".

<Callout kind="alert">

At the time of writing the list was empty, so its columns and row actions could not be documented. The Status filter currently lists order statuses rather than vendor statuses. This page will be expanded once store vendor data is visible.
